# Vendor blobs placeholder - Samsung Galaxy A53 5G

This directory is a placeholder for proprietary vendor blobs for
Samsung Galaxy A53 5G (SM-A536B/DS dual-SIM target variant).

## Expected workflow

1. Dump stock firmware images
2. Populate `proprietary-files.txt` with required blob paths
3. Add extraction scripts if you use a LineageOS-style workflow
4. Generate vendor makefiles from extracted files
